name: Hampi
description: Ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire scattered across a boulder-strewn landscape on the Tungabhadra river.

name: Majuli
description: The world's largest river island, home to centuries-old Vaishnavite monasteries called satras.

name: Rann of Kutch
description: A vast white salt desert that hosts the Rann Utsav festival with folk music, dance and handicrafts.

name: Khajuraho
description: Group of medieval Hindu and Jain temples famed for intricate sculptural art.

name: Ziro Valley
description: Home to the Apatani tribe, known for wet rice cultivation and the Ziro Music Festival.

name: Coorg (Kodagu)
description: Coffee plantation hills known as the Scotland of India, with Kodava culture and cuisine.

name: Varanasi
description: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities, ghats along the Ganga, evening Ganga Aarti.

name: Spiti Valley
description: A cold desert mountain valley with ancient Buddhist monasteries and stark Himalayan landscapes.

name: Chettinad
description: Region famed for grand mansions of Chettiar merchants and fiery Chettinad cuisine.

name: Gokarna
description: A temple town with quieter beaches, an alternative to nearby Goa.

name: Bishnupur
description: Terracotta temple town famed for the Bishnupur gharana of classical music and baluchari sarees.

name: Mawlynnong
description: Known as one of Asia's cleanest villages, with living root bridges nearby.

name: Pushkar
description: Lakeside pilgrim town famed for the annual Pushkar Camel Fair.

name: Munnar
description: Rolling tea plantations in the Western Ghats with cool weather year-round.

name: Orchha
description: A quieter medieval town of cenotaphs and palaces on the Betwa river, often overshadowed by nearby Khajuraho.
